Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Sadar (Sonki) P.S. Case No. 538/2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 307, 326A, 504, 506, 498A/ 34 of I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and later on Section 304B was added in the charge-sheet.
3. As per the prosecution case, petitioner along with his family members had committed murder of his wife.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has falsely been implicated in the case.
From the statement of the victim girl, it appears that the deceased was burnt by the petitioner and his family members.

Learned counsel Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.69187 of 2025(4)
dt.18-12-2025
further submits that the victim has given a false statement.
Learned counsel further submits that he has clean antecedent and he is in custody since 31.05.2025.
The petitioner undertakes to co-operate in the case/ trial.

5.
